scope: Exact three published high-priority Hays voucher sheets, university-verified contact routes and image-versus-data licensing status. Two curator requests prepared as UNSENT Gmail drafts; no contact made.

sources_and_access.source: Hagenbuch and Lemke 2015 direct printed publication
sources_and_access.evidence: Printed pages 85 and 78 screenshot reviewed this turn. Supports specified taxon/collector/year/county/herbarium citation, NOT any full-resolution individual sheet.
Official curator and email verified, TEX/LL collection; ask for scan, source barcode and determination history.
Current page verifies coauthor David Lemke's contact email. Separate historical herbarium list previously identified SWT curator.
Specimen data service exists, but direct search redirects anonymous browser to verify-human/login and exact record search could not be completed.

sources_and_access.source: UT Austin Plant Resources Center IPT
sources_and_access.evidence: Version Image1.154 published October 6, 2026; ~573k records with CC0 occurrence dataset statement. DOES NOT establish a CC0 license for individual specimen images.
Some UT image collections say noncommercial reproduction with conditions and permission for large-scale or commercial use. Must request exact image rights; no assumption all images available as CC0.

records.record_type: Hays County gathering cited in Hagenbuch and Lemke 2015 Appendix B
records.specific_review: Opened screenshot of 2015 p.85; exact same collector and collection number verified. Prior Hays photos show drooping spikelets and crown; original specimen image not obtained.
high_priority_diagnostics: Mature spikelet with rudimentary terminal floret and lemma anatomy
Ligule true membrane, erose/lacerate margin, 3–6 mm
Tightly clumped hard subrhizomatous base (no true elongated rhizomes)

records.record_type: Hays County gathering under Coelorachis cylindrica, a Rottboellia/Mnesithea genus-treatment alias
records.specific_review: Opened screenshot of 2015 p.78; exact Carr 10681 match. No barcoded UT sheet scan located, original pitted glume and sessile/pedicelled pair unexamined.
high_priority_diagnostics: Rachis joints disarticulating at spikelet-bearing nodes
Recessed sessile fertile spikelet and reduced pedicelled spikelet
Pitted lower glume on original collection and short knotty rhizomes

records.record_type: Hays County gathering under Coelorachis cylindrica, a Rottboellia/Mnesithea genus-treatment alias
records.specific_review: Opened screenshot of 2015 p.78; Sanders 4100 correctly cited. Still no original specimen pixels or barcode.
high_priority_diagnostics: Spikelet glume pitting and exact sessile/pedicelled pair
Source locality/date plus any later annotations

texas_state.subject: Request for Hays County Melica nitens herbarium voucher — Dingee 89 (SWT)
texas_state.requested: High-resolution existing scan or catalog barcode, collection label/date/locality and determination history, reproduction permission independent of access.

university_texas.subject: Hays County TEX/LL specimen scans — Carr 10681 and Sanders 4100 (Coelorachis cylindrica)
university_texas.requested: Existing digital scans or specimen barcodes for both TEX–LL Hays collections, label and determination history, separate image reuse authorization.

other_notes: No additional public specimen sheet, barcode or current image license was obtained; absence of search results does NOT imply the physical voucher is missing.
Historical locality from one curated citation and currently photographed Hays iNaturalist sample are not proof of same biological individual.
No new taxonomic decisions or false-exclusion score values should be added solely from this accession search.
This audit is public repo-safe: it contains only publicly listed curatorial contacts and reference metadata; no user's Gmail account identity, draft identifiers or private image bytes.
Next gate depends on actual original sheet media or expert look at a ripe same-local plant, not another generic photo; Chat 1 handles score admission.
Original photo rights, county-specific BONAP native map, cultivated versus established conditions and public-gallery pixel verification remain separate.
